# PawWork

> PawWork is a free, open-source desktop AI agent for macOS and Windows that helps people complete real work with local files, documents, spreadsheets, research, writing, code, and tools — no terminal, no API key required.

Last updated: 2026-08-20

## Key Links

- [Website](https://pawwork.ai/): Official landing page and download links.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Astro-Han/pawwork): GitHub repository (Apache-2.0).
- [Download](https://github.com/Astro-Han/pawwork/releases/latest): Latest macOS and Windows builds.
- [English README](https://github.com/Astro-Han/pawwork#readme): Full feature overview and FAQ.
- [Chinese README](https://github.com/Astro-Han/pawwork/blob/main/README_CN.md): 中文说明.
- [License](https://github.com/Astro-Han/pawwork/blob/main/LICENSE): Apache-2.0.

## About

PawWork brings AI agent work into a native desktop workflow. Users choose a workspace folder, describe a task in plain language, and review the steps, outputs, and generated files before using the result.

PawWork is built for everyday desktop work, not only browser chat or IDE coding. It supports documents, spreadsheets, PDFs, research, writing, code review, debugging, and local file tasks.

PawWork includes curated OpenCode Free models and built-in web search. It works without an API key or paid model subscription.

## What PawWork Can Do

- Extract invoice fields from PDFs into a reviewable spreadsheet draft.
- Summarize CSV data files and create short reports.
- Merge, split, and organize PDF and document files.
- Search the web and collect sources for research tasks.
- Turn notes and attachments into written drafts.
- Inspect code projects, review pull requests, and debug issues with logs and source files.
- Handle Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files locally on your machine.

## Platforms

- macOS: Apple Silicon and Intel, signed and notarized.
- Windows: x64, currently unsigned installer (SmartScreen may appear on first launch).

## Positioning

PawWork is an open-source alternative to Codex App and Claude Desktop (Cowork). PawWork differentiates with an Apache-2.0 codebase, free models that require no subscription or API key, local Office file handling, and a non-technical user focus with task cards instead of a terminal.

## Built On

PawWork uses DeepSeek DSH as its agent runtime and handles Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files locally.
